# CAPTURED FROM rtl_fm 2.0.2 (rtl-sdr 2.0.2-2+b1) on Raspberry Pi 4, 2026-06-02.
# Tuner: Rafael Micro R820T (RTL2838UHIDIR). Captured by bench/capture-stderr.sh
# scanning NOAA weather-radio freqs (162.4-162.55 MHz, always-on, squelch opens).
#
# CRITICAL FINDING: this rtl_fm version emits ONLY startup banner lines on stderr.
# It does NOT print any per-event lines while squelch-scanning — no per-channel
# 'Tuned to' line on squelch-open, no 'Signal level:' line, no 'Squelch closed'.
# Verified across squelch levels (-l 0, 50, 150) and single- vs multi-freq scans.
#
# Line meanings (startup only):
#   'Tuned to <hz> Hz.'  -> the INITIAL tuner CENTER frequency (offset-tuned, one-shot
#                           at startup; NOT a per-channel squelch-open indicator).
#   'Signal caught, exiting!' / 'User cancel, exiting...' -> shutdown (from our timeout).
#   All other lines are device/sampling banner.
#
# IMPLICATION: active-channel detection cannot come from rtl_fm stderr in this version.
# See escalation note — the parser/engine design needs an alternative signal source.
# Raw capture follows:
#
